description.zh:
RAM实体ID。

获取RAM用户ID的方法，请参见[GetUser](~~28681~~)。

获取RAM角色ID的方法，请参见[GetRole](~~28711~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the RAM entity.

For information about how to obtain the ID of a RAM user, see [GetUser](~~28681~~).

For information about how to obtain the ID of a RAM role, see [GetRole](~~28711~~).
The principal identity pattern. The pattern is in the format of `<PrincipalType>/<PrincipalName>`.

- RamRole：RAM角色。
description.en:
The type of the RAM entity. Valid values:

- RamUser: A RAM user.

- RamRole: A RAM role.
